label: representative_chamber

envelope.label: representative_chamber
envelope.purpose: Inputs for the layout feasibility check (scripts/layout_feasibility.py) and the layout comparison under uncertainty (scripts/layout_comparison.py). One baseline layout and a small set of alternatives on the representative 200 mm chamber. Every input says whether it is known (from the proposal or a cited source), assumed (a working value chosen here, to be replaced) or missing (a vendor or project input that no repository source provides; the value given is a placeholder or a bracket).

status_meanings.known: stated in the proposal (MBE_Phase1_Proposal_v1.2.pptx, ref/proposal/SLIDE_TEXT.md) or a cited reference
status_meanings.assumed: chosen here for the representative chamber; not a requirement and not a measurement
status_meanings.missing: a vendor or project input that must be obtained before design freeze; the value is a placeholder or bracket

net_growth_rate_um_h.note: Working rate of every earlier study; the project has no rate requirement yet (data/intake/machine_requirements.json: mean_thickness_or_growth_rate_constraint null). All layouts are compared at this equal wafer-mean net rate.

growth_temperature_C.note: The proposed machine's growth temperature on its own calibrated scale is not set. 700 C (narrow Ga window, temperature-insensitive thickness) and 740 C (wide window, 0.11-0.16 %/K) bracket the two regimes. Temperatures are the source labs' scales (growth.py).

droplet_onset_law.note: Literature disagrees by up to 3-4x at 700 C (data/parameters/gan_growth.json); the machine's own onset is a commissioning measurement. Treated as an uncertainty, with the centre Ga/N set from the onset at the centre (calibration).

usable_radius_m.note: Uniformity is evaluated on r <= 94 mm for every layout: the 3 mm holder overlap of the baseline holder (opening 97 mm) minus a 3 mm edge exclusion. The mask is the same for all layouts, so no improvement comes from changing it. Edge exclusion is missing in the intake ledger (edge_exclusion_m null).

holder_lip_height_m.note: Face-down wafer resting on the holder ledge; the ledge stands this far proud of the growth face and shadows grazing beams. Same as the heater model's ledge thickness.

holder_opening_radius_m.note: Holder design choice; the 1 mm overlap is the heater model's better edge support.

source_throw_m.source: R14 8-inch layout study; H02 gives a typical 10.5 inch (267 mm) for a plasma source

nitrogen_source_ports.note: One RF plasma source; the proposal states one 600 W 13.56 MHz source.

cell_cone_polar_deg.note: Common effusion-cell cone at the R14 / Ga-study optimum angle; cells spaced evenly in azimuth.

holder_assembly.note: Heater, holder and manipulator behind the wafer as one solid cylinder; a chamber drawing is missing (HARDWARE_EVIDENCE P0).

chamber_drawing.note: Port and flange schedule, cryoshroud, RHEED and pyrometer lines of sight (P0 request).

source_bodies.note: In-vacuum bodies as solid cylinders from the lip back to the mounting flange; shutter blades are disks on rotary arms beside the cell. Dimensions are typical of the stated flange classes, not drawings.

status.flange: known for the 1000 cc ABI class (H03: ABI 1000 on CF150)
assumed (H03 ABI 500 class on CF100; Al cell model missing, H04)

status.lip_radius_m: assumed (20 mm active plate radius of the nitrogen studies)
status.other: missing (source model not selected; HARDWARE_EVIDENCE H02)

hole_aspect_L_over_r.note: Shallow finite holes (R30's 0.343 mm holes in a 0.5 mm plate) are the leading candidate. L/r 0 is the ideal reference, not a manufacturable specification. L/r 5.8 (1 mm plate) is kept only as the alternative a source might require. The vendor plate drawing is missing.

output_profile.note: +/-50 % radial profiles moved the optima by at most 0.24 points (nitrogen_aim_robustness).

active_N_output_capability_atoms_s.note: Total active-N output versus power and flow is not modelled and no vendor value is in hand. It is bounded by the feed: at most 8.956e17 N atoms/s per sccm of N2 (nitrogen_source).

active_n_fraction_of_feed_atoms.note: Fraction of the N atoms in the N2 feed that leave the plate as growth-active N. No repository source gives it for any RF source (R10-R12, R18 are abstract-only or unread on this point). 1.0 is the atom-content bound (every molecule dissociated and emitted), not an achievable efficiency; the lower values bracket a partly dissociating source. Set at commissioning from the Ga-rich growth rate versus flow and power.

feed_limit_sccm.source: H02 (SVTA RF-6.02 sheet) lists 0.1-10 sccm; the selected source's flow range and MFC are not specified

plate.source: R30 (Veeco UNI-Bulb, about 2000 x #80 drill) in a 0.5 mm plate: L/r 2.92, the leading plate of the layouts. Thickness not published.
plate.note: Used for the hole Knudsen check at the operating feed; Kn >= 10 is the free-molecular validity criterion of scripts/nitrogen_plate_scenarios.py.

thickness_uniformity_target_pct.note: No agreed target (data/intake/machine_requirements.json). Results report the share of states within 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 % half-range/mean as tradeoffs, not as pass/fail.

minimum_growth_rate_um_h.note: No agreed minimum. Results report the rate each operating scenario can reach.

pointing_tolerance_deg.note: Axis tilt in any direction (a cone of half-angle tolerance).

tilt_pivot_behind_plate_m.note: A tilt adapter or flange machining error pivots the source about its mounting flange, which also moves the plate sideways. 0 m reproduces the plate-centred tilt of nitrogen_aim_tolerance.py.

tilt_adjuster_range_deg.note: Range of a tilting adapter, if one is fitted. A port whose axis is machined to the aim needs only trim.

rating_C.source: proposal slide 11; object of the rating (element, holder or wafer) is not stated (PLAN_REVIEW item 8)

element_temperature_limit_K.note: If 1200 C were the wafer rating the element would run hotter; the selected unit's element limit, zone power capacity and lifetime in active N must come from the vendor (H05 lists 1000 C standard, 1200 C on request).

zone_power_density_limit_W_m2.note: Not applied separately: at these temperatures the element temperature limit binds first (reported).

designed density.zone_edges_mm: 12 equal rings to 115 mm (a designed element pitch, not 12 controllers)

uncertain_properties.control: one wafer-temperature reading holds the wafer mean (all zones scaled together); the zone ratios stay at their nominal optimum

effective_N2_speed_m3_s.note: Proposal turbo >= 2000 L/s nameplate (known); the effective speed at the chamber is not.

collision_diameters_m.status: assumed (Ga: scenario range after the Bi2 result; N atom not sourced)

ga_source.note: A level melt in the 71.5 mm bore spills above R tan(angle): 37.0 mm at 46 deg, 49.2 mm at 54 deg. A 54 deg port gives up the fill range between 37 and 49 mm of recess.

A (baseline).description: All sources on the 46 deg cone aimed at the wafer centre; shallow-hole plate; 3-zone heater on a 3 mm overlap.

B.description: As A, but the nitrogen axis aimed off-centre from the same 46 deg cone (an off-axis port or tilted mount); designed-density heater on a 1 mm overlap.

C.description: Nitrogen on a steep 65 deg port aimed near the wafer edge; designed-density heater.

C-Ga54.description: C with the Ga cells on a 54 deg port (fills 70-120 mm only).

R0 (ideal reference).description: Thin plate (L/r 0) at its 45 deg / +55 mm optimum; designed-density heater. Not a manufacturable plate specification.

D (deep-hole alternative).description: L/r 5.8 (1 mm plate) at 65 deg / +110 mm, if the source hardware requires a thicker plate; designed-density heater.

warnings: Representative-chamber comparison; no model in the chain is validated on the proposed machine
Uncertainty grid, not a probability distribution: shares are over grid states
Conversion fraction of the N2 feed to active N is a missing input, set by scenario
Background attenuation removes direct beam only; scattered arrival not modelled
Attenuation and lip shadow as nominal-pose ratio profiles; free-molecular N plates with uniform output
Heater perturbations are not combined with each other; N profile and plate geometry are not in the grid
No uniformity target or minimum growth rate is agreed: threshold shares are tradeoffs, not pass/fail
